title: 05.02 - Save a PDF copy of a contribution
intent: Explain how participants can receive a PDF copy of their submitted contribution.
short_answer: Right after submission, EUSurvey offers the possibility to request an email with a PDF copy of your contribution attached. Use the Get PDF button on the Confirmation page.
procedure: On the Confirmation page, select Get PDF.
Request the PDF copy by email.
Save the received PDF for your records.
important_conditions: The Get PDF option is available on the Confirmation page after submission.
The PDF may include your contribution ID.
